Description.Name: Nobility Line
Description.Details:
Upon reaching the New Roland system, you send Sumire out in the Leopard to scan ahead at the coordinates that were provided by your mysterious would-be benefactor.

With both Dr. Murad and Yang riding along, you impress upon Sumire not to take any unncessary risks as she makes her final approach.  Patiently you await their reply.  

Finally, in what seems like forever, Sumire beams over the Leopard's cockpit view as they descend into a remote area hundreds of kilometers from the small mining town of Mikken's Outpost. At a glance, it looks like a normal ridgeline. Suddenly, the perspective changes as they land on an unnaturally flat plateau. Huge doors coloured to match the surrounding rock formation loom over the Leopard. 

Darius nervously bobbing his head, breaks the silence, "So far so good. Are you confident you can open the bay doors?"

Dr. Murad smiles, "It's password protected. Luckily, they also gave us the logins."

"Yeah, I don't see any defence systems at all Commander. Seems safe enough to me." ,Yang replies as he steps towards the console.

Dr. Murad sighs, "Well, here goes nothing..."

After entering the password on the console, N-O-B-L-E, the doors slowly open revealing a surprisingly small bay with lights triggering in a series of sharp snaps.

Giddy with excitement, Yang recklessly rushes in.

Description.Name: Continue
Description.Details: Sumire scrunches her nose and sarcastically blurts out, "Yay! It's a Spider." Dr. Murad nods in bewilderment, "This certainly was not what I was expecting." Darius turns to you, "Well, it's a free mech right?" "As long as no one got hurt. At least, this further legitimizes our mystery Samaritan's claims. They did say 250 tonnes total so I'm guessing there's a lot bigger mechs to find out there?" Yang already fidgeting in the Spider's cockpit interrupts the crew's disappointment, "Stop the Presses! This thing is heavily modified!" Sumire tilts her head and squints, "The cockpit does look a bit weird from what I can tell." Yang shakes his head, "You have no idea. The cockpit has been completely overhauled and reinforced. The weapons are SLDF stock and there's even what looks like a trap door allowing the pilot to eject! The entire console and sensors are cutting edge. Wait a minute? I can't believe it. Is that an ECM unit? Who are these guys?" Yang hops out of the cockpit and circles the mech, trying to make sense of it all. "This thing is still made of paper but with all the upgrades, you would have a tough time trying to land a hit on her. This is a certified gem, Commander!" Smiling you casually reply, "Wrap it up! We'll take it!" Dr. Murad quietly adds, "We also found a new set of coordinates and what I think is another system, Commander. Does the name Huanghuadian sound familiar to anyone?" Sumire shakes her head, "Never heard of it...sounds Capellan. Yang?" Yang grins, "Sure, but you won't find it on any maps - at least not on any of the current ones. Our old home is known as Tincalunas now." Darius folds his arms, "I thought you were from Bryant?" Yang nods, "I am but my family are of Huanghuadian descent, long before the Succession Wars drove us out. My Grandma would always tell me ancient stories about the old homestead." Pleasantly surprised, "OK, Tincalunas it is. Let's check it out as soon we can."
